name: cells
evidence: Map cell array, 13 B x N cells (unit, unit2, height, high, low, metal, feature, offsetY, offsetX, flags). Written every tick by AddUnitToMap, features, reclaim. Largest item: 13N bytes. Hash once per tick with a word-wise hash. Evidence: cell.h:11-23; line_of_sight.cpp:1086-1105 Hashed (#136) from a copy with two groups of bytes skipped, none of which any simulation code reads: flags bit 2 (info_panel_468cf0.cpp:582,594 set and clear it in the render pass, read only at :624), flags bit 7 (never written or tested), and bytes 10-11 (spot or footprint offsets) when the feature is not below 0xfffb or 0xfffe (every reader tests the feature first: features.cpp:535-541, terrain.cpp:505,525,724,837,903). Kept in the trace: high and low of the last column and row, which nothing writes (UpdateCellHeightRange stops at width-1 and height-1) and the game reads (BuildDerivedLayers cellp[5], ClearBorderFeatures c->low on a lava world, pass maps). Needs a #7 task: the state block must zero that memory (and #40 if a mod should fix it). Evidence: harness.cpp VisitMapCells; --poison dump diff.

Observed: eight-pincushion-teams tick 12047, units[259].list[0] (kind Reclaim, created that tick), pos.y differs between two runs of one exe while pos.x and pos.z agree. VTOL_Reclaim: the same call in VtolRepairPatrolOrder (vtol_orders_4152f0.cpp:160-170) builds new Order("VTOL_RECLAIM") from its own uninitialised energyPos and metalPos. Observed: long-great-divide-2p tick 30601, units[36].list[0] (kind VTOL_Reclaim, created that tick), pos.y differs between two runs of one exe. Readers of pos.y: ReclaimFeature and FindFeatureAtPos read x and z (vtol_orders_414770.cpp:115, :165); the PathOrder it builds (:132) is covered by the orderFx skip.

Every constructor argument member is set by the constructor (order_list.cpp:630-650), so the union is hashed whole and no member is skipped by order type. Skipped for build kinds: pos.y is skipped for the MobileBuild and VTOL_MobileBuild kinds (harness.cpp OrderIsBuild, matched by the kind table name). Writer of the unset value: ScoutTimer::OnTimer passes an uninitialised stack Vec3 (ai_player_408100.cpp:140-143) to FindBuildPosition (ai_player.cpp:1938), whose CellToWorld (ai_player.cpp:677-680) writes x and z only; GetOrderType and AddOrder copy it into Order::pos (order_list.cpp:641). MobileBuildOrder reads x and z only (unit_orders_403a20.cpp:111-122); SnapWorldPosToFootprint (terrain.cpp:798-805) writes y for bmcode 0 and returns for mobile types; CreateUnit (units_485010.cpp:921-923) copies pos in InitUnitFromType (:665) and UpdateUnitHeight (unit_position.cpp:323) recomputes y for a unit with motion (made for bmcode 1, units_485010.cpp:845) because InitUnitFromType sets flag 0x10000 (:651); DrawBuildFootprint only draws it. Observed: eight-pincushion-teams tick 12047, units[259].list[0] (kind Reclaim, created that tick), pos.y differs between two runs of one exe while pos.x and pos.z agree. VTOL_Reclaim: the same call in VtolRepairPatrolOrder (vtol_orders_4152f0.cpp:160-170) builds new Order("VTOL_RECLAIM") from its own uninitialised energyPos and metalPos. Observed: long-great-divide-2p tick 30601, units[36].list[0] (kind VTOL_Reclaim, created that tick), pos.y differs between two runs of one exe. Readers of pos.y: ReclaimFeature and FindFeatureAtPos read x and z (vtol_orders_414770.cpp:115, :165); the PathOrder it builds (:132) is covered by the orderFx skip.
